sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Hermes Agent is an AI agent from Nous Research that you run in your terminal or talk to from Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp and Signal. It learns as it works: it writes reusable skills after complex tasks, keeps memory, and can search its past conversations.
sixtySeconds.problem: Most agents forget everything between sessions and are tied to one model. Hermes keeps memory and skills across sessions, works with almost any model provider, and can run scheduled jobs unattended.
whoFor: Developers who want a terminal AI agent with memory
People who want an agent in their messaging apps
Users who want to switch freely between model providers
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it if you want one agent that learns over time, runs on a schedule and reaches you in chat apps, with no model lock-in. If you only need a coding assistant inside an editor, an editor-based tool may be simpler.
requirements: Linux, macOS, WSL2, native Windows or Android (Termux)
An API key or account for a model provider (Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI or your own endpoint)
The installer sets up Python, Node.js and other tools for you

overview: Hermes Agent has a full terminal UI with multiline editing, slash-command autocomplete, history and streaming tool output. A single gateway process also connects it to Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal and email, so you can continue a conversation across platforms.

Its learning loop is the main idea: the agent curates its own memory, creates skills after complex tasks, improves them during use, and can search past sessions. A built-in cron scheduler runs natural-language tasks like daily reports unattended, and it can spawn subagents for parallel work.

You choose the model with hermes model and can switch without code changes. It can run commands locally, in Docker, over SSH, or in cloud sandboxes like Modal, Daytona and Vercel Sandbox. Nous Portal is an optional paid subscription that bundles models and tools behind one login.

troubleshooting.problem: Windows Defender or antivirus flags uv.exe
troubleshooting.solution: It's a false positive for Astral's uv, which Hermes bundles. Verify it with the README's attestation steps, then whitelist the %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\bin folder.

troubleshooting.problem: hermes command not found after install

troubleshooting.solution: Run hermes doctor to diagnose issues.

bestFor: A long-running personal agent with memory
